findings.claim_text: Three separate retrievals of NVIDIA's 10 August announcement — from the newsroom, from the investor-relations site, and through a raw-text proxy — return zero occurrences of "residual," zero of "backstop," and zero percentages other than the headline capital figure.
Where the debt fully amortises inside the contract, residual value is a recovery buffer, not a repayment source — and a residual guarantee is close to redundant.
findings.contradicting_quote: The residual value assumptions baked into every GPU-backed securitization — 50% at three years — have been invalidated by the B200 in nine months.

findings.claim_text: On 10 August — the same day as the NVIDIA announcement — a $2.6bn facility priced at SOFR+550, wider than talk, on a structure whose roughly five-year maturity runs past the roughly three-year average customer contract.
